2608.13505.title: Intern-S2-Preview: Scientific Agentic Foundation Model
2608.13505.paper_summary: Scientific discovery increasingly requires AI systems that can reason over scientific evidence of heterogeneous modalities, interact with scientific tools and environments, and sustain progress across long task horizons. We present Intern-S2-Preview, a series of scientific agentic foundation models designed to support multimodal scientific understanding, reasoning, generation, and long-horizon tasks. The training pipeline begins with scientific multimodal pre-training over rendered scientific documents, interleaved image-text data, and diverse scientific corpora. Starting from the pretrained checkpoint, we apply a unified post-training pipeline consisting of supervised fine-tuning, scalable multi-task reinforcement learning (RL), black- and white-box agentic RL, and on-policy distillation. This pipeline is supported by practical techniques that improve rollout and training stability and efficiency, including partial rollout with off-policy correction, adaptive length regularization, online speculative decoding, robust multi-task optimization, and trace-aware experience assembly for agentic tasks. At the architecture level, Intern-S2-Preview-397B extends time series modelling from efficient long-sequence understanding to numerical forecasting, while Memory Decoder is studied as a separate memory-augmented path for rapid scientific specialization without modifying the frozen 397B backbone. Evaluations across scientific, multimodal, agentic, and general-purpose benchmarks show that Intern-S2-Preview-397B achieves competitive or leading results in multiple settings. The time series modules improve scientific signal understanding and forecasting on SciTS, while the separate Intern-MemDec-4B extension improves the Biology-Instructions average score from 56.92 to 60.32 without modifying the frozen 397B backbone.
2608.13505.paper_summary_zh: 科學發現越來越需要能夠對異質模式的科學證據進行推理、與科學工具和環境互動，以及在長期任務範疇內持續進展的 AI 系統。我們提出了 Intern-S2-Preview，這是一系列設計用於支持多模態科學理解、推理、生成和長期任務的科學代理基礎模型。訓練流程從對渲染的科學文件、交錯的圖像-文本數據和多樣的科學語料庫進行科學多模態預訓練開始。從預訓練的檢查點開始，我們應用一個統一的後訓練流程，包括監督微調、可擴展的多任務強化學習 (RL)、黑箱和白箱代理 RL，以及在線策略蒸餾。這個流程得到了實用技術的支持，這些技術提高了推出和訓練的穩定性和效率，包括帶有策略修正的部分推出、自適應長度正則化、在線推測解碼、穩健的多任務優化和針對代理任務的追蹤感知經驗組合。在架構層面上，Intern-S2-Preview-397B 將時間序列建模從高效的長序列理解擴展到數值預測，而記憶解碼器則作為一條獨立的記憶增強路徑進行研究，以便在不修改凍結的 397B 主幹的情況下快速專門化科學。對科學、多模態、代理和通用基準的評估顯示，Intern-S2-Preview-397B 在多個設置中達到了競爭或領先的結果。時間序列模塊提高了 SciTS 上的科學信號理解和預測，而獨立的 Intern-MemDec-4B 擴展則將 Biology-Instructions 的平均分數從 56.92 提高到 60.32，而不修改凍結的 397B 主幹。
